playbookOutputs: CIPC registration certificate (CoR14.3) and incorporation documents (CoR14.1, CoR14.1A, CoR14.2, MOI)
B-BBEE EME sworn affidavit (commissioned by the client)
playbookCommonFailures: All four proposed names rejected by CIPC
Certified ID or proof of address older than 3 months for a director / shareholder
Shareholding structure not confirmed, so share certificates and the BEE affidavit ownership percentages cannot be completed
SARS eFiling profile / tax representative not activated for the new company, so the TCS PIN cannot be requested
BEE affidavit returned unsigned or not commissioned

informationToProvide.label: Certified ID Copy (SA Citizens) or Certified/Apostilled Passport (Foreign Nationals) for All Directors & Shareholders
alternatives: Certified & apostilled foreign passport + valid permit (foreign nationals only)
informationToProvide.helpText: SA citizens must upload a certified SA ID (Smart ID front & back or Green Book), certified within 3 months. Passports are only accepted for foreign nationals.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Residential Address for All Directors (Not Older Than 3 Months)
alternatives: Official bank statement showing physical address
informationToProvide.helpText: Utility bill, municipal account, signed lease, or bank statement dated within 3 months in each director’s name.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of residential address dated within 3 months per director in the director’s own name. Also used for SARS Registered Representative activation.

informationToProvide.label: Four (4) Proposed Company Names in Order of Preference
informationToProvide.helpText: List 4 unique names in order of preference. Do not include special characters (!@#%). CIPC appends '(Pty) Ltd'.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Four proposed company names in order of preference, free of special characters.

informationToProvide.label: Shareholding Structure (Full Names, ID Numbers & Share % per Shareholder)
informationToProvide.helpText: List each shareholder, their ID/passport number, and percentage of shares (must total 100%) for issuing Share Certificates.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Shareholder names, ID numbers, and share percentages totaling 100%.

informationToProvide.label: B-BBEE Ownership Breakdown & Deponent Director Name
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify: (1) Total % Black Owned, (2) Total % Black Female Owned, (3) % Black Youth / Disabled / Unemployed / Rural (if any), and (4) Full name of the Director who will sign the B-BBEE Affidavit before a Commissioner of Oaths.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Exact Black Ownership %, Black Female Ownership %, designated group %, and full name + ID of the Deponent director for the dtic EME B-BBEE Sworn Affidavit.

informationToProvide.label: Public Officer / Representative Director Personal SARS Income Tax Number
informationToProvide.helpText: 10-digit personal SARS Income Tax number of the main director (required by SARS to link the new company on eFiling and issue the Tax Clearance PIN).
informationToProvide.aiHint: 10-digit South African personal income tax reference number of the Public Officer / Registered Representative.

informationToProvide.label: Company Registered Physical & Postal Address
informationToProvide.helpText: Full South African street address and postal code (cannot be a PO Box).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Physical and postal street address in South Africa for the company.

informationToProvide.label: Company Contact Phone Number
informationToProvide.helpText: Primary contact number for the business.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Valid South African contact phone number for the business.

informationToProvide.label: Company Email Address
informationToProvide.helpText: Primary email address for official company correspondence.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Valid email address for the company.

informationToProvide.label: Director(s) Cellphone Number(s) & Residential Address(es)
informationToProvide.helpText: Mobile number (for CIPC/SARS OTPs) and residential street address for each director.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Cellphone number and residential street address for every director.

informationToProvide.label: Director(s) Email Address(es)
informationToProvide.helpText: Direct email address for each director.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Valid email address for every director.

informationToProvide.label: Do You Want a Free FNB Business Bank Account Referral?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Yes/No preference for FNB business account referral.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect director/shareholder documents, names, shareholding and contacts
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certified IDs and proofs of address for every director and shareholder, four names, shareholding with race/gender, addresses, contacts and year-end received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: This package ends with a tax clearance PIN and a BEE affidavit, so ask up-front for the shareholding percentages and each shareholder's race and gender (needed for black-ownership % on the affidavit). Explain that the affidavit will need to be signed in front of a Commissioner of Oaths. Turnaround 7-10 working days end to end; never promise faster.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify documents and screen names
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All uploads pass; director/shareholder details extracted; names screened; shareholding totals 100%
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Extract names, ID numbers, DOB, addresses exactly. Run a CIPC name search for each name. Reconcile the shareholder list to IDs.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Reserve name and register the company on CIPC
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Name reserved and registration staged with all fields and certified IDs; Kevin has submitted; tracking number saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: As for Private Company Registration: CIPC e-Services / BizPortal, four names (CoR9.1), standard MOI (CoR15.1A), ID numbers typed exactly. ⚠ verify current fees. Record the tracking number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for CIPC registration
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR14.3, CoR14.1/14.1A/14.2, MOI and income tax number available
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check tracking status before following up. On name rejection request replacements and re-reserve.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft share certificates, securities register, BEE affidavit and first resolution
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Share certificates, register, EME sworn affidavit on the dtic template and first board resolution drafted with the new registration number
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: BEE affidavit: new company, so annual turnover is R0 / projected under R10 million = Exempted Micro Enterprise. Black ownership % = sum of shares held by black South African shareholders (as defined in the B-BBEE Act) — compute from the shareholding answer; 100% black-owned EME = Level 1, at least 51% = Level 2, otherwise Level 4. Never guess race — leave blank and flag if not answered. Deponent is a director. Share certificates numbered from 1.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send affidavit and share documents for signature and commissioning
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Commissioned BEE affidavit, signed share certificates and resolution uploaded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain that the affidavit must be signed in front of a Commissioner of Oaths (police station, attorney, bank branch — free) and every page initialled; the director signs the share certificates and resolution. Return as PDF.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Activate eFiling for the company and request Tax Compliance Status PIN
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Company registered on eFiling with a tax representative, TCS request submitted and PIN issued showing 'Compliant'
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Kevin — needs the registered representative process. Register the company on SARS eFiling using the income tax number from CIPC, appoint a director as registered representative (may require SARS online appointment with certified ID, proof of address and CoR14.3 — ⚠ verify current SARS requirements), then Tax Status > Tax Compliance Status Request > Good Standing. A brand-new company with no returns due is normally Compliant immediately. Save the PIN letter.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver the tender-ready pack
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All documents posted to Communication History in one pack
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: List each document and what tenders use it for. Explain that the TCS PIN expires after 12 months and the BEE affidavit after 12 months, and that the company must file annual returns and a beneficial ownership declaration. Offer CSD Registration as the natural next step.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
